title: Hub does not check room-policy-04 §8.2 metadata capabilities on room_metadata updates
description: hub/policy.rs policy_capability covers roles_list, preauth_list and base_room_policy only; an AppDataUpdate of room_metadata (protocol-07 §7.6) needs no capability, so any participant can change the room name, description, avatar, subject or mood. room-policy-04 §8.2 gives each field its own capability (canChangeRoomName ... canChangeRoomMood). Fix: compare the old and new RoomMetaData and require the capability of each field that changed. Found 2026-11-18 while doing mimid-d4i0 (decision mimid-1wgh.56 item 7).
notes: Already a documented limitation by decision mimid-1wgh.6.2 (mimid-server lib.rs # Limitations: §8.2 metadata capabilities not enforced). Kept open as the follow-up, now that default rooms give §8.2 capabilities only to the admin role.
